bolun: bol- — to become, to be; converb -un, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming 做了) [做了] · also 'when, at the time' (Ming 時) · also in neġükü bolun, 'when setting off, on starting' (the participle neġükü + bolun; Ming 做呵 'when doing'; uncertain) · also bol- 'to become' with converb -un in the sense 'together, as one' (Ming 共) · also bol- with the Ming 上頭 'on account of, therefore' [上頭] · also the Ming 欲做 'wishing to do, about to' (uncertain) [欲做] · also bol- 'to cease, stop' + converb -un (Ming 住) · also dobtulqu bolun 'about to charge, bent on charging' (Ming 要 'wish to'; compare bailduqu bolun) · also with Ming 做 'becoming' (plain converb, ködölkün bolun) · also 'consenting, willing' (Ming 肯) · also in ülü bolun 'not being willing' (bol- 'to be willing', Ming 肯)
ileġesü: ile- — to send (the Ming glosses 去 'go'); conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) sends' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form) [去呵]
burqan: Burqan — Burqan, the holy mountain (mountain name) [山名] · also Burqan, a man's name (Ming 人名)
ni: -(n)i — accusative, marks the object (e.g. ökin-(n)i 'the girl' as object); the Ming writes 行 (case suffix) [女 行] · also on names and on müren (Temüžin-(n)i, De-Sečen-(n)i, müren-(n)i), where the (n) is Shiratori's; in places topic-like, 'as for Temüjin' (Ming 行 or (行))
doṅγoduγ̇ai: doṅγo- — to sound, make a noise (Ming 作聲); ending -duγ̇ai uncertain ('before sounding' with üdüġüj-e) (verb) [作聲]
üdüġüj-e: üdüġüi — not yet (Ming 未); -e: dative-locative (j is a glide) [未(行)]
urida: urida — formerly, before, in front (adverb) [在前] · also 'first, beforehand' (Ming 先)
jadan: jada- — to be unable; converb -n, 'being unable' (verb, converb; Ming 不得) [不得] · also 'unable to' (Ming 不能), jada- with converb -n
böġetele: bü- — to be (böġe- before an ending); converb -tele, 'while, although' (verb, converb) [旣] · also bü- 'to be', converb -tele, 'while' (Ming 有間)
boltala: bol- — to become; converb -tala, 'until it becomes' (verb, converb) [到了]
ügüležü: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -žü, 'speaking' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [說著︀]
iležüġü: ile- — to send (as in ilebe, Ming 敎去了); past narrative -žüġü, 'sent' (verb, past narrative; uncertain: the Ming 去了有來 reads 'went', which would make the envoy the subject) [去了有來] · also past narrative 'sent', with Ming 來了有 and 去有來
tende: tende — there, then (from tere 'that'; locative adverb) [那裏]
ein: ein — thus, so (adverb) [這般] · also with Ming 是也 ('it is so'), 'thus, so' near the head of a clause (An-a ein eme Tajaṅ …; force uncertain)
büleġei: bü- — to be; -leġei past: 'there was, used to be' (a variant of -leġe; Ming 來) [有來]
araγača: araγača — as for, speaking of (Ming 論來; form unclear) (postposition or particle) [論來] · also 'going by, reckoning from' (Ming 料來 'reckoning, on estimate'; form still unclear)
an-dur: an — they, them (third-person stem before case endings); dative-locative -dur, 'to them' (pronoun + case; Ming 他每 行) [他每 行]
böġed: bü- — to be; ending -ġed, 'being so, even so', uncertain (verb, converb) [便] · also read as a particle of sequence, 'and then, thereupon' (Ming 便), as in süni böġed 'then in the night' · also (Ming 見有 'being, there being') 'being so'
žorižü: žori- — to aim at, point at, set out for (Ming 指); converb -žü, 'aiming' (verb, converb) [指着]
öġere: öġere — other, otherwise, different (adjective or adverb; Ming 別) [別] · also 'apart, separately' (Ming 𠮠)
küġün-dür: küġün-dür — to or with a person (küġün 'man' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [人 行]
teli: teli — that matter (reading uncertain; sense from the Ming 那事) (noun) [那事]
müṅke: müṅke — eternal (Ming 長生 'long life') (adjective) [長生] · also Müṅke, Müngke, a man's name (personal name; Ming 人名)
teṅgeri-de: teṅgeri — Heaven, the sky as a power; dative-locative -de, 'by, to' (front-vowel form; names the doer of a passive) (noun + dative-locative) [天 行]
igeġegdeġesü: igeġe- — to protect, to help (stem inferred from the Ming 護助); passive -gde-, conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) is helped, protected' (verb, passive conditional, front-vowel form) [被護助呵]
žiloγ̇a: žiloγ̇a — a part of a horse's harness (Ming 牽胷 'pull-breast', so perhaps a breast-strap; sense uncertain) (noun) [牽胷]
tatažu: tata- — to pull, draw; converb -žu, 'pulling'; the Ming reads 做妾着 'making a concubine' for the sense here (verb, converb; no other source known here for tata- with this sense) [做妾着] · also plain 'pulling' (Ming 扯着, 提着) · here 'wheeling about' (of reins or horses; Ming 掉着), and 'binding tight' (Ming 縛着)
ireġesü: ire- — to come; conditional -ġesü, 'when, if (he) came' (verb, conditional; Ming 來了呵) [來了呵] · also with the Ming 來呵 'if (he) comes'
boltuγai: bol- — to become, be; optative -tuγai, 'let it be, may it be' (verb, optative) [可] · also bol- 'to become, be', optative -tuγai, 'may it be' (Ming 做者)
